subject: Consolidate OEM + Cloud lead times for AtlasCloud dedicated capacity
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: oem-sales@nvidia.com, capacity@cloudzone.com, ravi.shah@atlascloud.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-20T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: AtlasCloud Dedicated: procurement lead time and capacity confirmation

Hi all,

We're working to finalize a Dedicated capacity commitment for AtlasCloud (DEAL-8791). High level ask: we need firm procurement lead times and any reservation windows you can hold for us so we can commit GPU counts tied to the customer's SOW.

Context: AtlasCloud has requested 150 H100-class GPUs (mix of 80GB and 40GB variants) for a Q1 2027 production cutover. The customer expects predictable throughput and wants a dedicated pool (no shared tenancy). Their procurement timeline is aggressive — they aim to sign and issue PO by mid-Oct.

Please confirm the following:
- OEM (NVIDIA): earliest ship windows for H100 80GB and H100 40GB if PO placed Oct 15 vs Oct 31; any minimum-split requirements; the lead time in weeks and any queue/backlog risks.
- CloudZone: for a Dedicated style offering (baremetal GPU pools / reserved instances), what commit lead times do you need to guarantee allocation for Jan-Feb 2027? Any regional constraints (we prefer us-west-2) and whether you can provide a soft-hold for the quantity while we finalize SOW.
- Any firm quotes you can attach and the PO cutoff to lock pricing/slots.

We'd like to consolidate vendor responses and return a single procurement recommendation to the customer by Sep 27 so Ben/Marissa and I can finalize the mutual action plan and procurement annex.

Attachments: required_spec_sheet.xlsx (internal spec matrix) — I'll follow up separately.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: NVIDIA Sales <oem-sales@nvidia.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-21T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: AtlasCloud Dedicated: procurement lead time and capacity confirmation

Hi Kimberly / team,

Thanks for the request — apologies for the short note but want to get preliminary windows to you ASAP. High level: H100 supply remains constrained but we can support a staged fulfillment plan.

Summary (preliminary):
- H100 80GB: current earliest ship window for new POs issued between Oct 1–Oct 15 is target shipment in the week of Jan 10, 2027. For POs placed after Oct 31, expect an additional 6–8 week delay (mid-to-late Feb shipping) depending on backlog. Lead time estimate: 10–16 weeks depending on PO timing and final model mix.
- H100 40GB: slightly better availability — earliest ships late Dec 2026 for Oct 15 POs; 8–12 week lead time.
- Minimum order: we can split orders but pricing tiers start at 32-unit increments for OEM channel pricing; smaller increments are possible but may carry a premium.

We attached a firm OEM quote and preliminary allocation terms. Key callouts: 1) a non-binding allocation hold can be set if a provisional PO is received by Oct 18; 2) firm pricing on the attached quote valid 30 days; 3) lead times are subject to allocation changes if demand spikes at end of Q4.

Attachment: NV_OEM_quote_AtlasCloud_20260921.pdf (OEM quote + allocation terms)

If helpful we can schedule a 30 min sync to walk through the allocation cadence and payment/acceptance terms.

Regards,
Sanjay Mehta
OEM Account Exec — Hyperscale & Partners
NVIDIA Sales

From: CloudZone Partnerships <capacity@cloudzone.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-22T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: RE: AtlasCloud Dedicated: procurement lead time and capacity confirmation

Hi Kimberly, Ben —

Thanks for the details. We can support a reserved dedicated pool in us-west-2 for a Jan 2027 cutover conditional on a 60-day lead time to stage hardware and networking. Two notes:

1) Reservation options:
   - Soft-hold: 30-day soft-hold on capacity numbers (non-binding), useful while you finalize SOW.
   - Commitment: 60-day lead time to convert soft-hold to committed capacity (we'll require a committed start date and a 6–12 month term).

2) Mixing OEM + Cloud instances: If you plan to supplement OEM-purchased hardware with our reserved instances, we can align instance types to provide identical node configs (GPU counts, NVLink where available) to simplify runtime portability.

3) Pricing & portal: attached our capacity statement and a link to our partner capacity portal. If you want us to provision a dedicated pool solely for AtlasCloud, we'll need a deployment window and a deposit (15% of first month) to lock slots.

Attachment: CloudZone_capacity_statement_20260922.pdf
Portal: https://partners.cloudzone.com/reservations/partner-requests/atlascloud

Happy to jump on a quick call to align calendar windows with NVIDIA shipments.

Best,
Maya Lopez
Partner Ops — CloudZone
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-24T17:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidate OEM + Cloud lead times for AtlasCloud dedicated capacity

Team — consolidating vendor responses and next steps (DEAL-8791):

Quick summary:
- NVIDIA: H100 80GB earliest ship ~week of Jan 10, 2027 if PO issued by Oct 15; otherwise shift into mid/late Feb. Minimum commercial split: 32-unit pricing bands (can combine mixes). OEM quote attached (NV_OEM_quote_AtlasCloud_20260921.pdf).
- CloudZone: can hold a soft-hold; 60-day lead to convert to committed capacity in us-west-2. Requires deposit to lock.

Risks & ask:
- Risk: If AtlasCloud misses Oct 15 PO window we push into Feb and jeopardize the customer's Jan cutover.
- Ask (Ben): push procurement deadline/PO guidance in the customer M.A.P. — propose Oct 13 as internal hard deadline to get signed SOW to procurement so we can submit PO by Oct 15.
- Ask (Marissa): run a capacity split scenario (A: OEM-first 150 units shipped Jan, B: hybrid — 100 OEM + 50 CloudZone reserved) with cost delta and expected latency/availability differences. Need numbers by Sep 28.
- Ask (Vivek): review the OEM quote for pricing carve-outs (volume discount bands) and confirm whether we should request a vendor exception for a smaller breakpoint to smooth debut.

Action items (owners / ETA):
- Ben Carter: update MAP and push for Oct 13 internal sign-off with AtlasCloud (ETA: 2026-09-27).
- Marissa Cole: capacity split analysis and operational checklist for hybrid deployment (ETA: 2026-09-28).
- Vivek Kulkarni: commercial review + negotiation points for NV quote (ETA: 2026-09-28).
- Kimberly: coordinate PO timing with NVIDIA and confirm deposit terms with CloudZone once we pick scenario (ETA: 2026-10-01).

Attachments: procurement_action_items_20260924.md
HubSpot: HS-37492

Thanks — we'll pick up a 15 min sync if any of the timelines slip.

-Kim
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
